## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds only Benign; the input is typical and the second model agrees.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 100%; others <1% | Strongly Benign |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99; 44th percentile | Typical, trustworthy input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Benign [F5] | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 0, 3, 10) · ↓ invasive · Two-layered lobular epithelium scores above typical [F2] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 4, 5, 7) · ↓ invasive · Prominent tubules associated with lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Validated
- **Lymphocytic infiltrate** (region 0) · context · Dense TILs score above typical [F4] · Weak
- **Immune cells near tumor** (regions 2, 6, 7) · context · Higher than 92% of reference images [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules (0/20) is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Top concept cue (normal lobules, 0/20 spot check) is unreliable; only tubules is a validated supporting concept.
- Small test set (132 images): calibration error CI reaches 0.18 and the conformal guarantee is dataset-level.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 3, 10:** confirm two-layered lobular epithelium; this concept failed its spot check.
2. **Regions 4, 5, 7:** confirm benign gland architecture, with no invasive pattern.
3. **Regions 2, 6, 7:** review nuclei HoVer-Net labeled neoplastic (62, 61, 25 cells).
